articles.title: Scorching Heat Forces D.C. to Cancel July 4th Parade, Fireworks Still On
articles.summary: A record-breaking heat wave with a heat index up to 115°F forced Washington D.C. to cancel its 250th Independence Day parade. The fireworks display remains scheduled, but severe thunderstorms could disrupt the evening.

articles.title: FIFA U-Turn Keeps England-Mexico at 1 a.m., Pubs to Stay Open Until 5 a.m.
articles.summary: After briefly considering an earlier kickoff, FIFA decided to keep England's World Cup knockout match against Mexico at 1 a.m. UK time. Pubs can now stay open until 5 a.m., but traveling fans are frustrated by the chaotic planning.

articles.title: Inside the 'Frantic' Scramble as Andy Burnham Prepares to Become PM
articles.summary: With Keir Starmer on his way out, Andy Burnham is poised to become Britain's next prime minister without a general election. Behind the scenes, a fierce competition for cabinet jobs is underway.
